speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat
text: asked	the Minister for National Development (a) what is the number of feedback and complaints which the Ministry has received from residents of newly-built executive condominiums (ECs) on defects and design flaws in the past five years; and (b) what is the role of HDB in helping to resolve such matters since ECs are part of the stable of public flats offered by HDB.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is done by imposing on EC buyers certain initial eligibility and ownership restrictions.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: But after the 10th year, all restrictions are lifted and the EC will be no different from other private condominiums.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: A lot of the public housing rules and regulations apply to EC, such as the Minimum Occupation Period (MOP) and even the resale levy.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: Would the Ministry consider assisting these residents to address all these defects, some of which are actually design flaws, in the official capacity as the housing authority?

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: Because some of these residents would have done their homework − they would have gone to BCA, they would have gone to a lot of places.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: They felt that because the EC is part of the housing options offered by HDB, HDB is the authority to help them.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: Not to help them resolve it, but at least help them to initiate a meeting to set the framework on how these developers can help them.

speaker: Mr Png Eng Huat (Hougang)
text: I have personally experienced, that in Hougang and it helps when HDB is involved; but that does not involve ECs, it involves a new BTO.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Both in the  supplementary question and in the Parliamentary Question, the Member has alluded to ECs as public housing.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: There are Government Land Sales and then there are EC land sales.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: Whilst these policies are in place, they make ECs an affordable way for people to enter into private housing.

speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
text: But that said, I think the Member's concern is about residents who face issues with ECs.
